SELECT DISTINCT e.`Symptoms`, p.`Diagnosis` FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.`Symptoms` IS NOT NULL AND p.`Birthday` = (SELECT MAX(p2.`Birthday`) FROM Patient AS p2 JOIN Examination AS e2 ON p2.ID = e2.ID)

SELECT Id, PostHistoryTypeId, CreationDate, Comment FROM postHistory WHERE PostId = 118 ORDER BY CreationDate ASC

SELECT PH.Comment FROM postHistory AS PH INNER JOIN posts AS P ON PH.PostId = P.Id WHERE P.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND PH.Comment IS NOT NULL AND PH.Comment <> '' ORDER BY PH.CreationDate ASC, PH.Id ASC
